text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another summer training camp has come to an end. And as for how hard Buena Vista worked, well, it was nothing short of incredible…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ………Zzz… Zzz……

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer…? Wait, did you finish your quota of making soba?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Wait, where am I…?
choice_data_list: Was I a soba chef or something?
Was I a soba chef or something?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa, that was a dream…! I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Yeah, I guess so. I really pushed myself hard.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Once we're back at the academy, I'll get plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, after making even greater growth during summer training camp, Buena Vista returned to the academy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …where a truly prestigious invitation was waiting for her.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: An invitation to an exhibition race…!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! A dream race of sorts, with top horsegirls from overseas taking part!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The organizers have specifically asked that Japan be represented by you, Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In both popularity and ability, you're at the top of Japan right now. You're being looked to as the face of the era!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The exhibition race would be something like a massive Grand Prix, with horsegirls chosen by fans from around the world facing off against one another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This dreamlike race is held every other year, and this year, it's being hosted here in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The official announcement hasn't been made yet, but I'm sure it will generate tremendous excitement among racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However! This came up rather suddenly, and it's already scheduled for next month…!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And, between you and me… it seems that most of the horsegirls actually competing will be those whose racing schedules have settled down.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course, your Twinkle Series schedule comes first. So please discuss it carefully with your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "They're holding a dream race! I wonder if Buena will be in it?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I hear they always get a legendary lineup… Could we see her race against that girl!?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista…"
"Buena…"
"I want Buena to race…"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I want to enter. Because…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If I race against horsegirls from all over the world and win… there's no doubt I'll be able to answer everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to make so many people happy. So…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Why?
choice_data_list: There are a lot of reasons…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are several major concerns, from how little time there would be between races to the fatigue she'd already accumulated. But the most important thing was…
choice_data_list: You look like you're rushing yourself.
You look like you're rushing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: I think there's something weighing on you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well…
choice_data_list: Feel free to tell me anything.
Feel free to tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (I see… maybe I was rushing myself. Thinking I had to answer even more expectations.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (The expectations just kept getting bigger… and no matter how many I answered… I couldn't see the finish line.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (I didn't know what I was supposed to be aiming for anymore…)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (The expectations… had started to feel so heavy.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…I'll talk about it. If it's the Trainer, then… we can solve anything together.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Trainer. I…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…Tell? How?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (That the expectations have become too heavy… that I'm rushing myself. Do I really should tell the Trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Show me the most breathtaking view ever!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Show me the most breathtaking view ever!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (The Trainer who's been believing in me all this time…?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ……No.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I don't want to tell you. Not you… not you of all people.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everything I've received until now… all those expectations, all that trust, all those sparkling feelings…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: They'd all get painted over. No… I don't want that. I don't ever want that…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Then… could you leave this to me? I'll handle this myself. I'll find a way.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm not a child anymore, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I still want to enter the exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I want to answer everyone's expectations completely, win… and make so many people happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone wants me to do it… I don't want to step away… Please!
choice_data_list: Are you really sure you can do this?
Are you really sure you can do this?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trust me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You know I'm invincible when you believe in me… right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking at it positively, facing horsegirls from overseas could serve as good preparation for victory in the Japan Cup, an international invitational race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More than anything, I believed in Buena when she said she wanted to overcome this on her own. She's a strong horsegirl… She'd made it this far by doing exactly that.
choice_data_list: Then let's adjust your training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll give it everything I've got! I will win!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll show everyone the view of victory they're all hoping to see… I promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista gives me a radiant smile. Looking at that expression… I can't help but feel that this choice must be the right one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Buena Vista's entry into the exhibition race was officially confirmed.
